description: Audio enhancer and sound equalizer for Windows.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { throw 'FxSound requires administrator rights to install.' }
if ($extract.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw ('FxSound payload extraction failed with exit code ' + $extract.ExitCode + '.') }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'FxSound x64 MSI was not extracted.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $cab -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'FxSound cabinet file was not extracted.' }
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { throw 'FxSound requires administrator rights to uninstall.' }
if (Get-Process -Name 'FxSound' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close FxSound before uninstalling it.' }

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'FxSound MSI is missing from the Scoop version directory; refusing to uninstall a different registration.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw ('FxSound MSI uninstall failed with exit code ' + $process.ExitCode + '.') }

notes: Uses the official FxSound installer and extracts its MSI/CAB payload into the versioned Scoop directory.
The application files are installed in the versioned Scoop directory via APPDIR=$dir.
The FxSound virtual audio driver is installed system-wide; this is not a fully portable installation.
The extracted MSI and CAB are retained in the versioned Scoop directory so uninstall uses this package's own MSI.
Install and uninstall require an elevated PowerShell session. Close FxSound before uninstalling.
